question: Jahnavi is the sister of Taruni. Taruni is married to Dilip. Dilip is the father of Raghu. Manoj is the son of Hema. Taruni is the mother-in-law of Hema. Dilip has only one son and no daughter. Jahnavi is married to Barun. Lekha is the daughter of Barun. How is Jahnavi’s sister related to Manoj’s paternal grandfather?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1547ed4a509f0a6bfe8df80f658e3f39359c9e9889086a7427a6110c94ecf76.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec7f858041f974a7bf51dd23712e9bfacdeaa77aa764eb3f54ffeab0a08ad199.png] 

Taruni is Jahnavi’s sister 

Dilip is Manoj’s paternal grandfather.

Clearly, Taruni is wife of Dilip.

Hence, '**Wife**' is the correct answer.
